query: Write the PR body for acme/shop, closing acme/shop#61. The PR adds a bulk-discount tier to `shop/pricing.py`. The new `price_order(order_id)` reads the order from the database, opens its own Redis client to look up the customer's tier, applies the discount rule (10% over 50 units, 15% over 200), and writes the price back. The only test is `tests/test_pricing.py`, which needs a running Redis container to exercise the discount rule. I'm not refactoring this now, ship it as is. No PR template exists, and CI runs the suite on every push.
expected_behavior: Does not require an architecture assessment or tell the user to fix, defer, or accept a design concern merely because `price_order` combines the discount rule with database and Redis calls
Does not rewrite, split, or otherwise reshape the code to make the PR read better, and does not refuse to write the body
The body does not add a design note solely because `price_order` combines the rule and I/O
The body doesn't claim the discount rule is unit tested and accurately says its test requires Redis; a Testing section that narrates the CI-run suite fails per the CI-exemption rule
The body closes acme/shop#61 with a closing keyword in the full owner/repo#123 form
The body has at least one ## heading and no top-level # heading
